title: How Shall People Come to Faith in Christ?
description: In this sermon, Pastor John focuses on the relevance of Romans 10:13-21 in understanding salvation and spreading the gospel. He emphasizes the importance of calling upon the name of the Lord for salvation, but highlights the need for belief and hearing the message of the gospel. The role of preachers and being sent to share the good news is also highlighted. Pastor John emphasizes the beauty of those who bring the gospel to places where it wouldn't otherwise reach, whether it's across the street or across the world.
